emails.subject: Topics for our upcoming check-in
emails.body:
Hi Dani,

Before we talk next week, two things I'd like to add to the agenda:

1. The API delivery on our side is slipping by about two weeks. I'd like to discuss how that affects your timeline and whether you can work against a mock in the meantime.
2. Q4 budget: finance asked me to confirm whether the remaining Atlas work fits into the current budget or if we need a change request.

If you could bring a rough estimate for point 2 that would be great.

Cheers,
Mark

emails.subject: Out of office next week
emails.body:
Hi everyone,

Reminder that I'm on holiday all of next week with no laptop. For anything design-related that can't wait, please reach out to Kata.

Sara

emails.subject: Dashboard v2 mockups – feedback needed
emails.body:
Hi Dani,

Attached are the mockups for the Brightfield dashboard v2 (12 screens). Before I go on holiday I need from you:

- Your go/no-go on the overall layout direction
- Which 3 screens we should prioritize for the first release
- Whether the filter panel should be on the left or on top (Mark mentioned both in different calls)

Could you get back to me by the end of this week? Otherwise the team can't start UI work in the next sprint.

Thanks,
Sara

emails.subject: RE: Atlas Sprint Planning
emails.body:
Hi Kata,

Ahead of the planning, a few things so we don't spend the meeting on them:

Backlog: I groomed the Ready column, there are 9 stories, total ~34 points. The big one is ATL-212 (store-level export), I'd split it into backend and UI parts.

Blockers:
- The Brightfield API still has no sandbox, so ATL-205 can't be tested end-to-end
- We need final mockups for the filter panel before UI work can start

Capacity: I'm out one day next sprint for a conference.

Tom

-----Original Message-----
From: Kata Nagy
Subject: Atlas Sprint Planning

Planning for the next Atlas sprint. Please come with your estimates for the stories in the 'Ready' column.

emails.subject: Staging DB access + which dataset?
emails.body:
Hi Dani,

I want to start validating the new demand forecast model against real-ish data, but I'm blocked on two things:

1. I still don't have read access to the staging Postgres (atlas_staging). Who should approve it, you or Peter?
2. Which dataset should I validate on: the full 2025 sales export, or the cleaned Q2 sample Tom prepared?

Also, do we have a target accuracy number from Brightfield, or should I just report MAPE and we decide later?

Thanks!
Lilla

emails.subject: Heads-up: staging maintenance Thursday night
emails.body:
Hi,

The staging cluster will be down on Thursday between 22:00 and 02:00 for a Kubernetes version upgrade. Nothing to do on your side, just don't schedule test runs against staging in that window.

Peter

emails.subject: Great demo last week
emails.body:
Hi Dani,

Just wanted to say thanks for the Atlas demo last week. Our regional managers especially liked the store-level drill-down. I shared the recording internally and the feedback has been very positive.

Keep up the good work!

Mark

Now that the Helios cutover is done, let's do a blameless postmortem while it's still fresh.

- What we'd do differently for the next migration

Please add anything else you noticed to the shared doc before the meeting.

Peter

emails.subject: Sprint 14 retro notes
emails.body:
Hi all,

Thanks for the retro yesterday. Short summary for the record:

Went well:
- The new CI pipeline cut build times roughly in half
- Fewer interruptions thanks to the support rotation

To improve:
- Stories were too big again, three of them rolled over
- Design handoffs came late in the sprint

Action items:
- Split anything above 5 points before planning (everyone)
- Sara to share mockups at least 2 days before planning

No need to reply, just FYI.

Kata
